highlights.text: Engaged in an ugly fight during the captaincy task with Qazi Touqeer, who threatened him.
Was involved in a multi-way first-week clash alongside Scout OP, Gullu, and Qazi Touqeer.
Almost got into a physical fight with Qazi Touqeer during a heated captaincy and movie task.
Fought alongside Kushal Tanwar and Yung DSA to become the first captain of the house.
Got emotional on Day 2 while recalling his grandfather's unfulfilled dream.
Broke down while recalling his grandfather's unfulfilled dream of wanting 12 tickets for his film.
Opened up about his deep affection for his mother and wife.
Competed against Gullu and Yung DSA in the fierce battle for the house's first captaincy crown.
